meta.title: Schedule send
meta.description: Defers work to DeepSeek's off-peak hours. The panel offers the next off-peak start (12:00 or 18:00) or another time; the draft becomes a one-shot @deepseek-ai/dsh-schedule task delivered to this conversation, and no model turn runs while you register it. Times use the browser's IANA zone, attachments are not included, and the task can be reviewed or cancelled in Automation tasks.
